        * (1.0 - di.wllatvar::numeric / 5.0) 
        * (1.0 + CASE WHEN di.wlchanhop THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::numeric / 2.0)

    * (1.0 + CASE WHEN di.wlchanhop THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::numeric / 2.0) 
    * ((ts.wlsignal::numeric + 100.0) / 100.0) > 8.5
ORDER BY wpr DESC;

WITH wpe_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        di.devregistry,
        ROUND(CAST(
            ((di.wlrangem::numeric / 10.0) 
            * (1.0 - di.wllatvar::numeric / 5.0) 
            * (1.0 + CASE WHEN di.wlchanhop THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::numeric / 2.0) 
            * ((ts.wlsignal::numeric + 100.0) / 100.0))
            * SQRT((ts.battlifeh::numeric * ts.battcapmah::numeric) / (di.pwractmw::numeric * 10.0) / 5.0)
            * (1.0 - di.wllatvar::numeric / 3.0)
            * 2.0
        AS numeric), 4) as wireless_performance
    FROM deviceidentity di
    JOIN testsessions ts ON di.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
)
SELECT devregistry, wireless_performance
FROM wpe_calc
WHERE wireless_performance > 8.5
ORDER BY wireless_performance DESC;
